from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u024/system/state/workspace/programs/task-4846aab6.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    separators = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == row[0] and v != 0 for v in row)]
    for s in separators:
        above_bound = max((x for x in separators if x < s), default=-1)
        below_bound = min((x for x in separators if x > s), default=h)
        above_colors = {v for row in grid[above_bound + 1:s] for v in row if v not in (0, grid[s][0])}
        below_colors = {v for row in grid[s + 1:below_bound] for v in row if v not in (0, grid[s][0])}
        shared = above_colors & below_colors
        for r in range(above_bound + 1, below_bound):
            rr = 2 * s - r
            if not (0 <= rr < h) or r == s:
                continue
            for c in range(w):
                v = grid[r][c]
                if v in shared and out[rr][c] == 0:
                    out[rr][c] = v
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p)
